_about: Differences between feature/interviewer-portal and the build that the section comparison accepts.

The CI job (.github/section-compare/run.mjs) fails on any section that is not a match unless it is listed here with the same status and, for 'differs', exactly the same reported differences (the harness reports up to the first eight).
An entry that no longer occurs is reported as stale; remove it in the same change that fixes it.
Changing this file is changing what CI accepts: say why in the pull request.

accepted.reason: The new hero carries js/hero-fluid.js as a module script at its Section 3 position (inside the hero, after .hero-wires). The harness strips the old page's scripts but parses the new page as built, so the script is the first difference and shifts every line after it.
